entries.speaker: How to Fight in Challenge Battles
entries.en: In a Challenge Battle, you will have to focus on[n]defeating your enemies, as well as how much[n]damage you deal to them.

entries.speaker: How to Fight in Challenge Battles
entries.en: To deal massive damage, increase your party's attack[n]power and lower the enemies' defenses. You can also[n]knock the enemy down and try for a Technical Attack.

entries.speaker: How to Fight in Challenge Battles
entries.en: You can achieve a high score by earning bonus points,[n]monitoring the order of battle, and knowing which[n]party member should receive a Baton Pass.
